figure_type: environment overview; no experimental measurements or results plotted
panel_aspect_ratio: 3:2, with all insets inside each original canvas
humanoid_box: v1 Brax-reference box material #C7B384, without sRGB-to-linear conversion; other manuscript colors unchanged
arm_image_transform: Uniform scaling only; original background, camera, materials and colors preserved.
palette: Manuscript teal #1F7A78, indigo #4B2E83, orange #D9660E, slate #3A4655 and associated pale fills

schematics.scanning_materials: Hard/Soft have the same nominal planar geometry. Spring icons and probe penetration depict contact response, not deformation of the rendered mesh.
schematics.hybrid: Three symbolic task-chart stiffness maps; colors are not world-space surface texture. Hybrid is planar only.
schematics.shapes: Representative normalized shape-family illustrations, not reconstructed or measured heightfields.
schematics.peg_pose: Nominal dashed outline and offset/rotated socket. Offset magnified for visibility, not an actual rollout pose.
schematics.peg_sensing: Same geometry as ID; arrows denote true versus biased wrench observations, not physical motion.

humanoid_arrows: Schematic task-intent annotations (force / translation / yaw), not trajectories or measured displacements.
